text:
By Isabel Baldwin in Philadelphia
Published: 00:22 GMT, February 14, 2025 | Updated: 00:22 GMT, February 14, 2025
It turns out that even championships have their disadvantages. According to freshly crowned Super Bowl winner Saquon Barkley, that is.
In his first season with the Philadelphia Eagles after the Blockbuster Free-agency reconciliation last year, the running back tasted the victory for the first time. And apparently it ‘sucks’ it – or at least part of it.
Barkley played a crucial role when he went to the largest stage of the NFL for the first time on Sunday and the Eagles helped to a 40-22 Super Bowl Lix break of the Chiefs of Kansas City in New Orleans.
The 28-year-old ditched the biggest debut season of every free agent in the history of Philadelphia with 2,504 total hasten and 18 rushing touchdowns, where the hasty yards were collected in the NFL history.
But Barkley, who was also called the attacking player of the year of the NFL last week, admitted that his hunger for glory was not saturated. If there is something, he has only become voriously.
‘T When I ago I had a hard time sleeping because I thought of how I am going to attack the low season, ‘well -known Barkley while he spoke with reporters while he greeted fans and served on a local reed cane Thursday.
Saquon Barkley admitted that there was part of winning the Super Bowl who ‘sucks’
The Eagles star told reporters that he could not allow himself to become entangled in the win
‘You are not the word greedily, but addicted to it. You want to find a way to keep that Lombardi trophy up again.
‘It’s a bit bad if you think about it because you can’t allow yourself to get caught up. I think you can appreciate the things that you achieve, but that’s how it is, you have to go further and do it all over again. That’s the dream. ‘
While Barkley and teammates AJ Brown and Jalen focus all their attention on securing their next championship rings before they even receive this year, the question raises: do they dare to dream of a dynasty?
“I said after the game:” Why can’t our dynasty start now? “At that time I probably had a little champagne and other things in my system,” Barkley said with a bitter grinning.
‘But you really can’t concentrate on that. It is difficult to win one. Then you record it, you enjoy the moment and you start again.
‘It starts again after Friday’s parade. We really celebrate that we are a super bowl champion, and then it is back to work. That is the beauty of the team that we have. Many boys have similar mentities.
